scripts.build:libs: npm run build -w @lexbridge/shared && npm run generate -w @lexbridge/database && npm run build -w @lexbridge/database
scripts.build: npm run build:libs && npm run build -w @lexbridge/api && npm run build -w @lexbridge/worker && npm run build -w @lexbridge/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:libs && concurrently -n api,worker,web "npm run dev -w @lexbridge/api" "npm run dev -w @lexbridge/worker" "npm run dev -w @lexbridge/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @lexbridge/shared && npm run typecheck -w @lexbridge/database && npm run typecheck -w @lexbridge/api && npm run typecheck -w @lexbridge/worker && npm run typecheck -w @lexbridge/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @lexbridge/shared && npm run build:libs && npm run test -w @lexbridge/api && npm run test -w @lexbridge/worker
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:libs && npm run db:migrate && npm run test:integration -w @lexbridge/api
scripts.db:seed: npm run build:libs && npm run seed -w @lexbridge/database
